content: Bot detection research: behavioral features (login frequency, play time, game money, IP count; action sequences like sitting/healing, exp earning, harvesting, portal use). Heuristics: actions at too-exact intervals (low timing variance = bot), rate vs fastest human possible, CAPTCHA escalation on suspicion, private rotating challenge questions. Behavioral biometrics: movement/input pattern variability, chat/social interaction analysis. Economic approach (Verisoul): target bot profitability via dynamic spawn rates, transaction limits, honeypots. Discord-specific: Poketwo autocatchers are real and widespread (selfbots with OCR captcha solving, configurable catch rate/delay, priority lists, duplicate caps) -- Discord ToS bans selfbots. Anti-spam per-user spawn cooldowns and multi-user conversation requirements are the primary mitigation at the game level. Known weakness: heuristics produce false positives; dedicated players will cry wolf; randomness added by botters defeats naive detection.
